items.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Like George Martin with the Beatles. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, yeah.

ctx.x: Well the James Brown job was most challenging too because he would — James Brown would just sing stuff off the top of his head but you had to do it. He would say, “Okay use a harp right here.” A harp? What did James Brown want with a harp in his band you know? But he had to have this harp, and he’d say, “Okay we want a cello solo in this part.” A cello solo? Why? I cannot do this. You know? But you’d have to make it work. Had to make it work. And he would say, ah, you see, you didn’t think it would work did you.…

Wow. That is a challenge because people who don’t know about the limitations of instruments or in scoring and all that stuff, but they get these marvelous ideas in their head. Like George Martin with the Beatles.
